description: Operational Specialists of OPSEC Gauntlet. One entry per office in SPECIALISTS/. id matches data-tg-office-ep-id on the office page and data-character on the homepage corridor card. voice_id is the ElevenLabs voice used by tg-voice; an empty string means no voice is assigned and tg-voice will not serve audio for that office.

specialists.name: Ms. Ivy
specialists.domain: Concept hardening: gap map, unsupported claims, scope and boundary, assumptions requiring validation
retrieval_scope: academic literature where the topic crosses research
consumer review platforms and community forums
regulatory filings and compliance docs where relevant
specialists.method: Dr. O's SLR adapted for ideas instead of papers (intel-dashboard Card 5 pattern): topic -> keyword architecture (anchor + 4 secondary lenses + modifiers) -> conceptual sweep -> twin outcomes (what exists / where the gap is). Ideas are returned as one candidate per lens so they map to different cells of the space.
